stories.title: Welsh Government estimates put Flintshire small business rates relief at £4.99m this year, down from £6.30m
stories.summary: About 6,500 small businesses in Wales are paying business rates for the first time after this year’s revaluation, according to FSB Wales. The Federation of Small Businesses says the firms have been pushed over the £6,000 threshold for full Small Business Rates Relief, which has not changed since 2018. stories.title: Flintshire roadworks: closures in Shotton, Bagillt, Flint and Penymynydd from Monday
stories.summary: Stag Lane in Shotton and Bagillt Road in Bagillt are closed from today until Friday 20 November, as a busy week of roadworks gets under way across Flintshire. stories.title: North Wales Police urge drivers to check tyres, brakes and lights for Road Safety Week
stories.summary: Officers are reminding motorists of the legal 1.6mm tread limit and the rules on brakes, lights and windscreens as darker, colder months arrive.

stories.title: Three Mold restaurants given top food hygiene rating
stories.summary: Three Mold restaurants have been given the top food hygiene rating of five.
